summary: P0.1 verdict_card + P0.2 seven-panel Analyst Workspace refactor — full backend+frontend validation. All 4 pytest cases PASS (malicious PS, empty, benign plaintext, chain-recipe wrapper). All Playwright checks PASS: 7 panels present in exact locked order inside data-testid='analyst-results', verdict populates as Malicious 90% / 90/100 with 8 indicators, MITRE=3 techniques, Network=2 endpoints (URL+IP), all 7 collapse toggles flip aria-expanded, all 7 copy buttons clickable without throw, verdict-panel-header computed position=sticky, no horizontal overflow at 900x900 or 1440x900.
critical_code_review_comments: AnalystResults.jsx: ioc-copy button is disabled=True when no non-network IOCs are present (empty test payload had only URL/IP → moved to Network group). This is correct behaviour but click test on a disabled button becomes a no-op — worth double-checking test coverage in a case with hash/file IOCs.
VerdictPanel default state renders with all-zero placeholder if verdictCard is null-ish; combined with backend fallback card guarantees the UI never shows 'null'. Good defensive layering.
P0.1 backend correctly suppresses exception details — no 'Traceback'/file paths appeared in verdict_card.reason across malicious/empty/benign paths.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0.1/P0.2 verified end-to-end on 2026-01. Backend endpoint /api/decode/smart returns non-null verdict_card with full canonical schema (label/verdict/confidence/risk_score/reason/indicators/recommended_action) in all tested paths. Frontend AnalystResults renders 7 panels in this locked DOM order: verdict-panel → recovered-payload → chain-recipe-panel → mitre-panel → iocs-panel → network-panel → behavior-panel. To retest, use encoded PS sample from problem statement — expected verdict is Malicious ≥90% conf, ≥90/100 risk, 3 MITRE, 2 network endpoints (http://192.168.1.1/p.ps1 + 192.168.1.1).
